what: Put a WhatsApp button next to every phone number HQ shows: each lead, and the owner on a gym page
why: Indian gym owners answer WhatsApp before calls; today a lead and an owner show only a call link, so a follow-up text means copying the number into WhatsApp by hand
impact_why: Used on every lead follow-up and every owner contact, the main daily sales task
my_view: My view: do it; one extra link per number that opens WhatsApp to that mobile, no message written for him.

what: After Make a gym or a new sign-in code, add "Open in WhatsApp" that opens a chat with that owner with the message already filled in
why: The card already has the owner mobile and the ready message, yet he must press Copy, open WhatsApp, find the owner and paste: four steps where one would do
impact_why: Every new gym and every lost sign-in goes through this card; the code only lives 30 minutes
my_view: My view: do it, but he still presses Send in WhatsApp himself; keep Copy for when the owner uses another number.

what: Give Leads a Show filter (New first; Won and Lost hidden by default) and make the Needs you lead line open only the new ones
why: Needs you says "N new leads to call" but opens the full list of every lead for 12 months, won and lost mixed in, so he scrolls to find the new ones
impact_why: Grows worse with every lead; small today
my_view: My view: do it; the same Show box the Feedback page already has.

what: Let a lead carry a "call back on" date, and list leads due today on Needs you
why: A lead marked Called or Demo drops off Needs you for good; nothing reminds him to call back. Sales tools such as HubSpot CRM and Zoho CRM (follow-up tasks with due dates, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) are built around this
impact_why: A demo with no follow-up is the most common lost sale for a one-person sales desk
my_view: My view: worth building next after the quick wins; one date box per lead and one Needs you line. Needs a small database change, so his yes first.

what: Add two call lines to Needs you: free trials ending in 3 days, and trial gyms with no desk activity for 3 days
why: The gym list already counts trials ending soon, but only on its tiles; Needs you, the page he opens first, never asks him to call a gym before its trial runs out or while it is going quiet
impact_why: Trial to paid is where the money is decided; a call in the last days is the cheapest lever he has
my_view: My view: do it; the numbers are already read for the gym list, so this is mostly a new line and a filter.

what: On a gym page, show what this gym sent (feedback and help questions) and where it came from (its lead); make the gym code on a feedback card a link to that gym
why: Before calling an owner he must open Feedback and Leads separately and match the gym by code by eye
impact_why: Saves a search before every owner call and stops a call that misses an open complaint
my_view: My view: do it in two steps; the link from feedback to the gym first (small), the lists on the gym page later.

what: Add a private note box on each gym page ("owner wants Hindi bills, call after 6 pm")
why: Leads have a note but a gym does not; once a lead becomes a gym, what he learnt on calls has nowhere to live
impact_why: Helps every repeat call as the number of gyms grows
my_view: My view: do it later; carry the lead note over when the gym is made from a lead. Facts about the gym only, never member details, and it goes in the HQ log like other HQ actions.

what: Reorder the gym page: facts and owner first, then day-to-day tools (plan, status), then a folded "More tools" for rare or risky ones (sign out everywhere, new sign-in code, AI limits, support access)
why: The gym page stacks about a dozen cards in one long column, with Sign out everywhere above AI credits, so a phone user scrolls past risky buttons to reach common ones
impact_why: Every gym visit; also lowers the chance of a wrong tap on a risky action on a phone
my_view: My view: do it with the next HQ change, not alone; pure layout, nothing new to test except the fold.

what: Saved replies: a short list of ready answers he can drop into a feedback reply and edit
why: Each reply is typed from blank, and many questions repeat (how to check in, how to pay). Help-desk tools such as Intercom (Macros), Freshdesk (Canned responses) and Zoho Desk (Templates) all have this, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
impact_why: Grows with members; cuts reply time and keeps answers the same each time
my_view: My view: wait until he answers more than about 5 questions a week; until then the English helper is enough.

what: Show how members' shared links turn into gyms: leads from members, how many became Won, and a Show filter for them
why: Leads shows only "From members' shared links: N of M", so he cannot see whether the recommend-to-your-gym loop makes any paying gym
impact_why: Few leads today; matters once the member app is widely used
my_view: My view: do it with the Leads filter (the Show filter idea), same change; one more count on one line.

what: After "Add a person", open that person's sign-in code straight away, with Send on WhatsApp ready
why: Today the owner adds the person, the sheet closes with a toast, and he must then find the new row and tap Make sign-in code: a second trip for the one thing every new person needs
impact_why: Every new staff member and trainer goes through this; it is the first thing a new gym does after Create my gym
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the code sheet that already exists, and keep a "Not now" for an owner adding someone who is not at the desk.

what: Add a Manager kind of person: front desk rights plus money totals and receipt cancels, set by the owner
why: Rights are only Owner or Staff today; a typed job like Manager is a label and changes nothing, so an owner who has a manager must either make him a full owner or keep doing cancels and day totals himself. Glofox and Mindbody let the owner choose staff permissions per role (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: Bigger gyms with a manager hit this daily; single-owner gyms never do
my_view: My view: discuss before building; it touches money rights, so start with one fixed Manager set (totals plus cancel receipt), not a tick-box screen, and the server must enforce it, not only the panel.

what: In the "Sign out of this device?" sheet, when work is still waiting, add a "Send now" button and list what is waiting
why: The sheet only says to wait for All sent and greys out Sign out; at closing time the staff member has no button to push the sends and no idea which payments are stuck
impact_why: Happens at shift end on desks with weak internet, exactly when cash is waiting
my_view: My view: do it; the panel already has a send-everything routine, so this is a button and a short list.

what: Remember the last mobile number used on this device, so a returning person types only the PIN
why: The sign-in form always starts empty unless another screen passes a number in; on a shared desk computer each shift change means typing the 10-digit number again
impact_why: Sign-ins are rare because sign-ins do not run out, so the saving is small per gym
my_view: My view: do it only with a "Not you?" link to clear it, and keep only the number, never the PIN.

what: Cut "PIN again" from Create my gym and use a show-PIN eye instead
why: Create my gym already asks for gym name, your name, mobile, PIN, PIN again, a terms tick and a WhatsApp step: seven things before the owner sees his gym, and the repeat box is one of the easiest to drop
impact_why: One less box at the moment a new gym owner decides whether to carry on
my_view: My view: worth a small test, not a sure win; the repeat box guards against a typo locking the owner out on day one, so only drop it together with a show-PIN eye.

what: On the sign-in code sheet, let "Copy" copy the whole ready message (code, number and link), not just the 6 digits
why: Copy takes only the code, so an owner who sends it by SMS or another app has to type the link and the mobile himself; the full message already exists for the WhatsApp button
impact_why: Only for owners who do not use WhatsApp for staff, which is a minority in India
my_view: My view: do it as a second button "Copy message"; keep "Copy the code" for reading it out.

what: When the owner is the only person on Staff & sign-in, show one line asking him to add his front desk, saying why it helps
why: A gym with only the owner listed sees just his own row and an Add button at the top; nothing says that adding staff gives each receipt the name of who took the cash and lets him stop sharing his PIN
impact_why: Shared owner logins hide who took cash; the nudge pushes gyms toward named staff, which also keeps them using the panel
my_view: My view: do it; one line and a button in the empty state, no pop-up.

what: Fingerprint or face sign-in on the device instead of typing the PIN
why: Some banking and gym apps let a returning person sign in with the phone's fingerprint (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live); here every new sign-in is mobile plus a 6-digit PIN or code
impact_why: Sign-ins do not run out today, so people rarely type the PIN; the gain is small
my_view: My view: do not build now; it is a large change across browsers for little daily gain. Revisit only if sign-ins start to run out after a time limit.

what: After a logo upload or a colour change, keep a "Not saved yet" bar with Save pinned to the bottom of the screen, and ask before leaving the page with unsaved changes
why: The logo uploads at once but members get it only after Save, which sits at the very bottom under four cards; leaving the page throws the new logo and colour away with no question
impact_why: Every owner who sets a look meets this once; a lost logo makes them think the upload failed
my_view: My view: do it; a pinned bar and a leave-page question are small, and they stop the most likely way the first set-up goes wrong.

what: After Save, show "Your new look is also on" with one-tap links: print the new join poster, the member card, the gym web page and the growth report
why: The logo already flows into the poster, member card, web page and growth report, but Branding never says so, so owners do not reprint the poster that brings new members in
impact_why: Turns a one-off settings visit into a fresh poster on the gym wall, the main way members find the app
my_view: My view: do it; the links point at screens that already exist, and the poster is the growth step that matters.

what: Give the join poster a band in the gym's own colour (top or bottom strip), like the member card already has
why: The poster is always white with black words; only the logo is the gym's, so it looks like MettleUp's poster rather than the gym's
impact_why: A poster that looks like the gym gets put up; one in someone else's style often does not
my_view: My view: do it, but a thin strip only, so printing stays cheap on a desk inkjet.

what: Show the opening screen too: a small second preview of the logo-on-launch screen next to the Workout tab and home-screen icon
why: The words say members see the logo big when the app opens, but the preview never shows that screen, so owners cannot judge how their logo looks large
impact_why: Helps owners pick between the cleaned and original logo; nice, not urgent
my_view: My view: worth doing with the next Branding change; not on its own.

what: Let an owner try their logo and colour in the phone preview before the member app is turned on, then show "Turn on the member app so members see this"
why: Today a gym without the member app sees only a "Turn on the member app first" card, so the most visual reason to turn the app on is hidden until after they do it
impact_why: Seeing their own gym in a phone is a strong push to switch the member app on, which every later growth step depends on
my_view: My view: do it; it reuses the same preview and needs only a "not saved, app is off" state. Branded-app sellers such as ABC Glofox, PushPress and Mindbody lead their sales with a mock-up of the gym's own app (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live).

what: Add six starter colour dots (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple tuned for the dark screens) above the colour code box
why: An owner with no logo, or a logo with no colour, must use a colour wheel or type a code like #E11D48, which many gym owners have never done
impact_why: Only for owners without a usable logo colour; the logo suggestion already covers most
my_view: My view: do it only if the set-up step numbers show owners stopping at Colour; otherwise skip.

what: Offer an "Ask MettleUp to set it up" button on Branding that sends the logo to the team, instead of the long ChatGPT steps for a logo with a photo behind it
why: The help for a busy logo asks the owner to use ChatGPT or Gemini, write a prompt and re-upload; many owners will stop here and keep a logo that looks poor on dark screens
impact_why: Only for logos with a photo or pattern behind them; the plain-box case is already automatic
my_view: My view: not now; first count how many logos are kept with a busy background. If many, a done-for-you set-up is a good paid-plan perk.
